Description: Creates an area of up to 20'R about the point touched. The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile target, it will move with the target. See Section 7.1.7.
Target can see 100' in normal darkness as if it were day.
Caster can vary the intensity of darkness in the area, but he cannot lighten it past its natural state.
As Darkness II, except radius is 100'.
As Nightvision, except caster can see in all darkness (even magical).
As Dark Control II, except range and radius are 50'.
Caster can create either the visual illusion of shadowy figures, or real shadows (as many as the caster's level); they will move when he concentrates. See Section 7.1.27 for more on illusions.
As Darkness II, except radius is 300'.
Creates a 20'R area of darkness. No nonmagic light can exist and magic light (except Utterlight) must make a RR or be cancelled.
As Dark Control II, except range and radius are100'.
As Dark Vision, except the target can see as far as he would be allowed in daylight.
As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 100'.
As Darkness II, except radius is 500'.
Creates a "cloud" of darkness that has a 100'R and drifts with the wind. The darkness can vary in intensity from an overcast day to the dark of night.
As Nightvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.
As Lesser Utterdark, except area of effect is 200'.
As Darkvision, except affects a number of targets equal to caster's level.
As Clouds of Darkness I, except for area of effect.
As Darkness II, except radius is 1,000'.
As Lesser Utterdark, except radius is 300'.
As Darkness II, except radius is 100' per level of the caster.
As Clouds of Darkness I, except radius is 1 mile per level of the caster.
